title: Coil Efficiency Bench: paired, load-matched analysis of motor-efficiency measurements
description:
Coil Efficiency Bench checks whether a proposed motor coil-winding or topology change is associated with an efficiency difference in paired, same-load measurements. From a CSV of baseline and candidate rows (input power, shaft torque, speed and load), it computes efficiency per row and reports the mean paired change, its standard deviation, a Student's t 95% confidence interval and a comparison against a practical threshold fixed before the analysis. Input is validated strictly, and output for the bundled sample is labelled synthetic.

Scope: it is a data-analysis utility, not a physics simulator, motor controller or measurement system, and it does not implement the IEC 60034-2-1 or IEEE 112 test procedures. Results describe only the tested hardware and conditions. The bundled measurements are SYNTHETIC and only demonstrate the format.

Usage: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only; pip install . adds a coil-bench command. Run python3 coil_bench.py data/synthetic_measurements.csv --threshold-pp 2.0 (add --json for machine-readable output). Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (run in CI on Python 3.10 to 3.13 with coverage).

Citation: cite the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23067995 for all versions, or the version DOI of the release you used. Source code: github.com/sparkainlp-x/coil-efficiency-bench. Licence: AGPL-3.0-only; commercial licensing is available (see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md).
notes: Evidence status: SYNTHETIC example data; no field performance is claimed. Commercial licensing: see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md.
